title: Page 10
content_zh:
她的话没能说完，因为被他紧紧抱住，然后被堵住了嘴——用唇。
火辣辣的一吻过后她头都晕了。
“你——”
眼前放大的男性脸庞闪耀着纯然的喜悦，双眼亮晶晶的，好像刚中了彩券的兴奋模样，他出乎意料之外的反应让她呆住了。
“你没有要走吗？”
“我才不走，怎么可能走？我刚才听到我最想听见的话！”
“你喜欢我，很爱我、很爱我，对不对？”
这人怎么……这么恶劣？
她不回答，他就硬缠着她，非要她说出来，直到她红着脸小声说出了那三个字时，他发现快乐得低吼声，接着又把她吻了个七荤八素。
好不容易喘过气来，范蕙怡瞪着浑圆的大眼看着他。
“到底是怎么回事？你不是想起来了？不是想跟孙小姐复合吗？”
“复合？你哪来这么荒谬的想法？”
“你约了她到办公室！”
“天！这样你就吃醋了？我只是想跟她说清楚，那时候我根本没跟她交往，只是一起出去吃了几次饭而已，我要她以后别搞不清楚状况，也别再来纠缠我了。”
原来她从头到尾都搞错了吗？想起自己一整天的心里挣扎，鼓起勇气把自己搞成这样，还……还说了那么多丢脸的话！
啊啊啊啊——
“你昨天晚上自己一个人出去，后来也没有打电话给我。”她心有不甘的指控，还想为自己的行为找合理的理由。
“我那时刚想起一切，脑袋混乱得不得了，头也痛得要命，只是需要时间好好整理一下。连这么点小小的空间你都不给我吗？太严苛了吧？”徐士凯哭着一张脸，冤枉的说道。
她一点都不同情他。真正苦的人是她好不好？她竟然讲了那些话！真的——好丢人。
“别这样嘛，承认爱我很难吗？刚刚不是还那么勇敢。你知不知道我听到你的那些话有多感动？现在证明我们是两情相悦了。你爱我，我也很爱你。”

恶心的话他说来毫不费力，她却听得满脸通红。
“你真的想起过去了还喜欢我？”
“嗯。”
“可是我平凡得很，个性也不够坦率，不会撒娇，也不——”
“不许你这么批评我心爱的人。”他打断她的话。“我一点都不觉得你平凡，在我眼里没有比你更可爱、更温柔的女人。你不会撒娇，那正是我最喜欢你的一点，看你认真专心工作的样子，让我每次都想把你压倒，好好地爱你。”
她面红耳赤的娇嗔。“你、你脑子里到底都在想什么啊！”
被一阵粉拳捶打的徐士凯招架不住，将她的两手困在他的手中，顺便也把她整个人圈进怀里，紧紧固定住。
“不要再怀疑我的爱了，我是真的爱你、想要你。”从他的拥抱、他炙热的胸膛、急促的心跳，还有那无法掩藏的硬挺……
她清楚他有多想要她。
范蕙怡突然不知道该怎么呼吸了，空气变得稀薄，然而在他低头吻住她之前，她那如火烤棉花糖那样柔柔热热软软的脑袋里，挣扎着想到唯一一个问题。
“那你当初为什么要跟我分手？”
听到这句话他全身僵硬，不自在的避开了她的视线。
“过去的事，不重要了吧？咳，反正我们现在在一起就好了。”他说完马上吻住了她，堵住她继续开口的可能。
热烈的情火燃烧着，两人很快的就忘了那些问题，也忘了需要的答案。
他们拥有彼此，这才是最重要的。
胸口涨满了幸福与喜悦，那个吻持续了好久、好久……
番外——分手的理由
事情的起因是在数月前。
徐士凯跟大熊——褚天阔是多年的好友，徐士凯总是这么笑称他。说起来他们会成为朋友也很令人跌破眼镜，因为他们的个性可说是南辕北辙，一个长袖善舞，一个不善言词；一个勇于冒险，一个保守固执。
一般人看到诸天阔的外表都会退避三舍，严峻冷酷的面容、高大壮硕的身躯，真的让人相当害怕，更别说是要上前跟他攀谈几句了。

不过在徐士凯眼中，褚天阔是个绝佳的听众，他不多话，看人的眼睛却相当诚恳，偶尔也会适时提出中肯的建言。
“到底怎么回事呢？”徐士凯烦恼的抓着黑发。“我实在想不出原因，从来没有一个女人能让我感觉这么难以捉摸，我都对她那么好了，却总是觉得她对我有所保留。”
在褚天阔老婆开的小兔咖啡屋里，两个男人坐在吧台，徐士凯的面前摆了一瓶几乎见底的威士忌。
“没理由啊！我交往过的女人总是才见过几次面就以我的女友自居，不是千方百计想要到我家去见我爸妈，要不然就是把我带去给她们的亲友炫耀，可是蕙怡却好像我是什么丢脸的东西似的，连见也不让我见她妈妈一面。
还有啊，要她搬到我那去住她也不愿意，从来不会主动联络我，也不曾开口说过爱我、想我、没有我不行之类的话。”
褚天阔挑起英挺的浓眉。
没听好友跟他抱怨过这种问题，以往他抱怨的内容总是哪个女孩太过黏人、哪个女人占有欲太强，这次的抱怨内容还真新奇。
什么时候也轮到大情圣徐士凯为情苦恼了？想必他一定爱惨了这个女孩。他是不好意思直说，但其实他想告诉好友的是——
这回你栽了！
“我不懂女人在想什么。”一直沉默的褚天阔开口。“我的经验也寥寥可数，不过我跟若曦分手以后再复合，感情反而更好了。”他的神情变得温柔，因为想到亲爱的老婆。
眼睛一抬，不由自主的凌巡亲亲老婆的身影。
乔若曦仿佛有心电感应，原本在摆放餐具的动作停了下来，跟老公的视线相接，甜甜一笑。
徐士凯没有注意到注意到好友脸上出现的傻笑，他有种当头棒喝的感觉。
“为什么分手以后反而感情会更好？”他从来没有想到自己有一天会跟大熊寻求感情的咨询，但现在他用力抓着他的领子，紧张的问。
“也许是分开以后才能体会到对方有多重要吧！”
徐士凯愣了一下，脑袋不停转着，然后嘴角慢慢浮现一抹诡异的微笑。
“谢了！兄弟，这回你大大帮了我一个忙。”
褚天阔不知道自己说了什么让徐士凯那么感谢，不过他那疯疯癫癫的模样还真是少见。
爱情能让人变得不像自己，爱情能让人一下子陷入痛苦深渊，一下子又仿佛上到天堂，这点他亲身体验过。
他同情的拍拍好友的肩。“加油！保重。”

徐士凯跟范蕙怡来到小兔咖啡屋，今天是来送喜帖的。
“恭喜！”褚天阔依然惜字如金。
他的妻子乔若曦则健谈得多。“真是太好了，前一阵子我们还好担心你们呢！什么暗杀、受伤、住院的，真是经历了许多不得了的事呐！”
“是啊，不过经历过那些只有让我们的感情更加坚定。”
徐士凯捏了捏范蕙怡的手，还不太习惯在别人面前表现亲热的范蕙怡红了脸，想抽回手，他却不放，她只有含嗔带怨的瞅他一眼。
那一眼却让徐士凯骨头都酥了，抓起她的手放在唇边一吻。
这人还真是得寸进尺！范蕙怡羞得只想找个地洞把自己埋起来。
“看来那招果然有效。”褚天阔突然冒出没头没尾的一句感慨。
“老公你说什么？”乔若曦偏着头问。
老婆的问题他一向坦承回答。“之前他们交往的时候士凯很苦恼，说觉得蕙怡对他们的感情还有保留，那举我们的例子说我们分手以后再复合，结果更珍惜对方，他就决定如法炮制。”
content_en:
She couldn't finish her words because she was hugged tightly by him and then gagged - with her lips.
She felt dizzy after the passionate kiss.
"You——"
The enlarged male face in front of her was shining with pure joy, and his eyes were bright, as if he had just won the lottery. His unexpected reaction made her stunned.
"Aren't you leaving?"
"I'm not leaving, how could I leave? I just heard what I wanted to hear most!"
"You like me, love me, love me very much, right?"
Why is this person so... so evil?
When she didn't answer, he kept pestering her, forcing her to say it. When she blushed and whispered those three words, he roared with joy, and then kissed her passionately.
After finally catching her breath, Fan Huiyi looked at him with big round eyes.
"What's going on? Didn't you remember? Don't you want to get back together with Miss Sun?"
"Getting back together? Where did you get such a ridiculous idea?"
"You made an appointment with her to come to the office!"
"Oh my god! Are you jealous like this? I just want to make it clear to her that I didn't date her at all at that time. We just went out to eat a few times. I want her not to be confused about the situation in the future and not to pester me again."
Did she get it wrong from beginning to end? I thought about the struggle I had been having all day, mustering up the courage to do this, and... saying so many embarrassing things!
Ahhhhh——
"You went out alone last night and didn't call me afterwards." She was unwilling to accept the accusation and wanted to find a reasonable reason for her behavior.
"I just remembered everything at that time. My head was extremely confused and my head hurt terribly. I just needed time to sort it out. Don't you even give me such a small space? Isn't it too harsh?" Xu Shikai said unjustly with a crying face.
She had no sympathy for him. She is the one who is really suffering, okay? She actually said those words! Really - so embarrassing.
"Don't be like this. Is it difficult to admit that you love me? You were so brave just now. Do you know how touched I was when I heard your words? Now it's proven that we are in love. You love me, and I love you too."
He said the disgusting words effortlessly, but she blushed when she heard them.
"Do you really remember the past and still like me?"
"Yeah."
"But I'm very ordinary, and my personality is not frank enough. I don't know how to act coquettishly, and I don't -"
"You are not allowed to criticize my beloved like this." He interrupted her. "I don't think you are ordinary at all. In my eyes, there is no woman more lovely and gentle than you. You don't know how to act coquettishly. That's what I like most about you. Seeing you serious and focused on your work makes me want to overwhelm you every time and love you properly."
She was blushing and angry. "You, what on earth are you thinking about in your head!"
Being beaten by a burst of pink fists, Xu Shikai couldn't resist, so he trapped her hands in his, and at the same time, he encircled her whole body in his arms and held her tightly.
"Don't doubt my love anymore, I really love you and want you." From his hug, his hot chest, rapid heartbeat, and the hardness that cannot be concealed...
She knew how much he wanted her.
Fan Huiyi suddenly didn't know how to breathe, and the air became thinner. However, before he lowered his head and kissed her, her head, as soft and hot as a roasted marshmallow, struggled to think of only one question.
"Then why did you break up with me in the first place?"
Hearing these words, his whole body stiffened and he avoided her sight uncomfortably.
"What happened in the past doesn't matter anymore, does it? Well, it'll be fine if we're together now anyway." After he said that, he immediately kissed her, blocking the possibility of her continuing to speak.
With the passion of love burning, the two quickly forgot about those questions and the answers they needed.
They have each other, that's what mattersof.
My chest was filled with happiness and joy, and the kiss lasted for a long, long time...
Extra - Reason for breaking up
It happened a few months ago.
Xu Shikai and Big Bear Chu Tiankuo have been friends for many years, and Xu Shikai always calls him this with a smile. It's surprising to think that they will become friends, because their personalities are completely opposite. One is good at dancing, the other is not good at talking; one is adventurous, and the other is conservative and stubborn.
Most people would shy away from Zhu Tiankuo when they see his appearance. His stern and cold face and tall and strong body are really quite intimidating, let alone having to go up and chat with him.
However, in Xu Shikai's eyes, Chu Tiankuo was an excellent listener. He didn't talk much, but he looked at people with sincerity, and occasionally made timely and pertinent suggestions.
"What's going on?" Xu Shikai grabbed his black hair in worry. "I really can't think of the reason. There has never been a woman who can make me feel so elusive. I am so good to her, but I always feel that she has reservations about me."
In the Little Rabbit Cafe opened by Chu Tiankuo's wife, two men were sitting at the bar, and an almost bottomed bottle of whiskey was placed in front of Xu Shikai.
"There's no reason! The women I've dated always consider themselves my girlfriend after we've only met a few times. Either they try their best to come to my house to meet my parents, or they take me to show off to their relatives and friends. But Hui Yi acts like I'm something to be ashamed of, and won't even let me see her mother.
Also, she was unwilling to move to my place. She never contacted me proactively, and never said anything about loving me, missing me, or not being able to live without me. "
Chu Tiankuo raised his handsome thick eyebrows.
He has never heard his friends complain about this kind of problem to him. In the past, he always complained about which girl was too clingy and which woman was too possessive. The content of his complaints this time was really novel.
When will it be Xu Shikai’s turn to be troubled by love? He must have loved this girl terribly. He was embarrassed to say it directly, but what he actually wanted to tell his friend was——
This time you failed!
"I don't understand what women are thinking." Chu Tiankuo, who had been silent all this time, said. "I have very little experience, but when Ruoxi and I got back together after we broke up, our relationship became even better." His expression became gentle because he thought of his dear wife.
Lifting his eyes, Ling Xun couldn't help but kiss his wife's figure.
Qiao Ruoxi seemed to have telepathy, she stopped placing the tableware, looked at her husband, and smiled sweetly.
Xu Shikai didn't notice the silly smile on his friend's face, and he felt like it was a wake-up call.
"Why does the relationship get better after a breakup?" He never thought that one day he would seek relationship counseling from Daxiong, but now he grabbed his collar and asked nervously.
"Maybe you can only realize how important the other person is after we are separated!"
Xu Shikai was stunned for a moment, his head spinning, and then a strange smile slowly appeared on the corner of his mouth.
"Thanks! Brother, you helped me a lot this time."
Chu Tiankuo didn't know what he said to make Xu Shikai so grateful, but his crazy appearance was really rare.
Love can make people become unlike themselves. Love can make people fall into an abyss of pain and then feel like they are in heaven. He has experienced this personally.
He patted his friend's shoulder sympathetically. "Come on! Take care."
Xu Shikai and Fan Huiyi came to Xiaotu Coffee House to send wedding invitations today.
"Congratulations!" Chu Tiankuo still cherished words like gold.
His wife Qiao Ruoxi is much more talkative. "That's great. We were so worried about you a while ago! You've been through a lot of incredible things, including assassinations, injuries, and hospitalizations!"
"Yeah, but going through those things only made our relationship stronger."
Xu ShikaiShe squeezed Fan Huiyi's hand. Fan Huiyi, who was not used to showing affection in front of others, blushed and wanted to pull her hand away, but he didn't let go. She could only look at him with anger and resentment.
That look made Xu Shikai's bones tremble. He grabbed her hand and put it to his lips for a kiss.
This man is really pushing his limits! Fan Huiyi was so ashamed that she just wanted to find a hole in the ground to bury herself.
"It seems that the trick is really effective." Chu Tiankuo suddenly sighed with no beginning or end.
"Honey, what did you say?" Qiao Ruoxi asked, tilting her head.
He always answered his wife's questions frankly. "Shikai was very distressed when they were dating before. He said that he felt that Hui Yi still had reservations about their feelings. Then he took our example and said that we got back together after breaking up and ended up cherishing each other even more, so he decided to do the same."
